name: Silenced (CR +3)
body:
Certain colonies of The Mechanism long ago perfected the technique of creating undeath, resulting in completely energy-neutral intelligent beings which can exist eternally in a stable state. The fact that these undead seem to shut down all light and sound around them has earned them the moniker of “silenced” from those species which have come across them. Few of the silenced made their conversions to undeath willingly despite the retention of their intellect, and populations are split between spreading their eternal state and ensuring that no other being has to endure such unlife.

Silenced is an acquired template which can be applied to any undead, hereafter referred to as the base creature.

A silenced creature uses the statistics of the base creature except as follows.

Challenge Rating: As base creature +3.

Aura: A silenced creature gains the following aura.

Aura of Stillness (Su)

A silenced creature is constantly surrounded by a 30-foot aura which suppresses all sound as per the silence spell and all light as per the deeper darkness spell. This aura also suppresses any senses which would be based on scent, heat, or electricity.

Senses: A silenced gains the see in darkness universal monster ability and touchsight out to 60 feet.

Armor Class: Natural armor bonus increases by 4.

Defensive Abilities: A silenced creature gains immunity to cold, fire, and sonic damage as well as fast healing 5.

Special Qualities: A silenced creature gains the following special qualities:

Necrowave Speech (Su)

A silenced creature can communicate telepathically with all other undead within 400 feet of itself.

Unto Nothingness (Ex)

When a silenced creature is destroyed, its soul is also destroyed permanently, the creature not capable of being resurrected by any means.

Ability Score Modifiers: Strength +6, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +4.
